resources.string: How Fitness OS uses Health Connect

Fitness OS uses Health Connect to access activity and workout information that you choose to share. You can change these permissions at any time in Health Connect's settings.

Fitness OS only requests read access to your daily step count and your exercise sessions. Fitness OS does not request write access, and does not request heart rate, sleep, location, nutrition, weight or body composition data.

Fitness OS keeps working normally whether or not you grant this access.
